chapters.slo_codes: No SLO codes; 12 unnumbered learning-outcome bullets

chapters.title: Chromosome and DNA
chapters.slo_codes: No SLO codes; 22 unnumbered learning-outcome bullets
chapters.main_concept: Molecular genetics: chromosome morphology and organisation (nucleosome, chromatin fibre, chromatid), genes and alleles, the Griffith and Hershey-Chase experiments establishing DNA as hereditary material, the three replication models with the Meselson-Stahl proof and the enzymatic mechanism of replication. Gene expression via the genetic code, transcription (initiation, elongation, termination, post-transcriptional modification) and translation (activation, initiation, elongation, termination), gene regulation, and point and chromosomal mutations with human disorders.
